title: Gold Shimmer Abaya
subtitle: Statement open abaya in luxurious bronze-gold shimmer fabric
description: Turn heads in this stunning bronze-gold shimmer open abaya. Crafted from a fluid, lightweight metallic fabric with an incredible drape, this floor-length piece is perfect for Eid celebrations, weddings, and formal occasions. The wide batwing sleeves and open-front silhouette create an effortlessly elegant look worn over any outfit.
